memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night will never cease." - Gen 8:22 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God closes His promise with words of beautiful stability: "seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night will never cease." After the great upheaval of the flood, God promises the steady, dependable rhythms of creation. The seasons will turn, the days will dawn, the harvests will come - faithfully, reliably, as long as the earth endures.

Every one of these rhythms is a quiet testimony to God's faithfulness. When the sun rises each morning, when the seasons change on schedule, when seeds planted in spring yield a harvest in autumn - this is not mere nature running on its own. It is the faithful God upholding His creation, keeping His promise day after day, year after year.

We so easily take these things for granted. But the regularity of sunrise and seasons is one of God's constant gifts, a daily reminder that He is dependable and true to His word. "Great is your faithfulness," the prophet wrote, marvelling that God's mercies are "new every morning" (Lam 3:22-23) - as sure as the dawn itself.

The same faithfulness that governs the seasons governs God's care for you. The God who never fails to bring the harvest will never fail to keep His promises to His people. When life feels uncertain, look at the steady rhythms of creation and remember: the God who keeps the seasons turning is keeping you. His faithfulness is as certain as tomorrow's sunrise.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you see God's faithfulness in the ordinary rhythms of each day and season?
- How does creation's reliability strengthen your trust in God's promises?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Faithful God, thank You for the steady rhythms of day and night, seedtime and harvest - daily reminders of Your faithfulness. When life feels uncertain, help me trust the God who keeps the seasons and keeps His promises to me.
